title: vitis micans
intro: Vitis micans, commonly known as the Purple-leaf Grape or Purple-leaf Vitis, is a plant species in the grape family with purple-colored leaves. The health benefits of Vitis micans include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Vitis micans include its ability to protect against cardiovascular diseases, reduce the risk of certain cancers, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Vitis micans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
